gloss: to wilt; to lose energy; to go limp

definitions.explanation: For plants to droop or lose freshness due to lack of water or heat.

definitions.gloss: to lose energy; to become dispirited
definitions.explanation: To lose motivation, enthusiasm, or energy, often due to disappointment or exhaustion.

definitions.gloss: to go limp; to lose strength
definitions.explanation: For body parts to become weak or lose their power.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}さで{花|はな}が{萎|な}えてしまった。
examples.english: The flowers wilted from the heat.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{態度|たいど}にやる{気|き}が{萎|な}えた。
examples.english: His attitude made me lose my motivation.

examples.japanese: {衝撃|しょうげき}で{足|あし}が{萎|な}えて{動|うご}けなかった。
examples.english: My legs went weak from the shock and I couldn't move.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive verb)

CONJUGATION:
Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}/{下一段|しもいちだん})
・{萎|な}えない (negative)
・{萎|な}えて (te-form)
・{萎|な}えた (past)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・やる{気|き}が{萎|な}える - to lose motivation
・{気持|きも}ちが{萎|な}える - to become dispirited
・{足|あし}が{萎|な}える - legs go weak
・{手|て}が{萎|な}える - hands go limp

RELATED WORDS:
・しおれる - to wilt (mainly for plants)
・{萎縮|いしゅく}する - to shrink, to atrophy
・{衰|おとろ}える - to weaken, decline

USAGE NOTES:
In casual speech, often used to express disappointment or loss of enthusiasm, similar to English "that killed my vibe" or "I lost steam."
